changelog: Architecture pass (1.4.0): intentional client Core (PageTitle, shared API/UI, CustomPage lifecycle), design tokens shared by Stats/Studio, and shared TMDB defaults on the server. Same features — cast/crew, bumpers, stats, studio pages — with less temporary glue.
description: Fetches complete TMDB cast and crew for movies and series, groups people by department, and shows them in a polished accordion on Jellyfin Web item detail pages. Includes a nostalgia Break Bumper action, Library Stats, and studio detail pages.
name: Full Crew
overview: Full cast and crew by department, break bumpers, library stats, and studio pages
